description: Selected platform-reported watch volume and commissioned fan-survey observations. Counts represent views or hours, not distinct people; fan-survey percentages apply only to stated samples.

observations.population: Videos related to Minecraft; cumulative lifetime
observations.limitations: Not a 2024 annual count or number of fans.

observations.population: Videos related to Roblox; cumulative lifetime
observations.limitations: Cumulative and potentially overlapping Minecraft audience; not unique viewers.

observations.population: Videos related to Pac-Man
observations.limitations: Annual video views, not distinct gamers.

observations.population: Videos with both halloween and makeup in the title
observations.limitations: Videos with 'halloween' and 'makeup' in their titles, global, Jan 1–Oct 5 2025. Keyword subset, not all makeup videos or unique viewers.

observations.population: Videos with both prom and GRWM in their titles
observations.limitations: Keyword-defined overlap; not general fashion demand.

observations.population: Videos with tier list in their title
observations.limitations: Format across many interests; not a single subculture audience.

observations.population: Selected sample of 300 virtual creators
observations.limitations: Selected creators, not representative of all virtual creators.

observations.population: U.S. subset of the selected 300 virtual creators' views
observations.limitations: Subset of the global sample, must not be added to global tally.

observations.population: News content watched on YouTube
observations.limitations: Platform-defined news content; hours are not unique people.

observations.population: Connected-TV news watching, a subset of total news watch hours
observations.limitations: Subset of news-watch-hours-2025, not additional viewing.

observations.population: Online animation fans aged 14–24, n=358, who watch animated series created for YouTube weekly or more
observations.limitations: Commissioned survey of animation fans, not percent of all U.S. YouTube users.

observations.population: Online animation fans aged 14–24, n=358, who agree indie YouTube animation is as enjoyable as or better than major-studio series
observations.limitations: Opinion within selected fan survey, not overall audience composition.

observations.population: Online animation fans aged 14–24, n=379, who watch animation memes weekly or more
observations.limitations: Commissioned online fan survey, not all Mexican youth or all YouTube users.

observations.population: Online animation fans aged 14–49, n=733, who agree they watch animation series in other languages
observations.limitations: Selected animation fans; no causal evidence of monetization.

observations.population: Videos with "desk setup" or "#desksetup" in the title
observations.limitations: Title-based content sample; not a census of users or all workspace-related videos.

observations.population: Videos with "drum cover" in the title
observations.limitations: Title-based count for one music format; not unique fans, all drummers or creator income.

observations.population: Videos related to Five Nights at Freddy's
observations.limitations: Related-video category spans multiple genres and formats; not unique gamers or viewers.

observations.population: Deduplicated people who watched FIFA World Cup 2026-related videos on YouTube during the tournament
observations.limitations: Distinct viewers of content related to a defined event, not subscribers, all soccer fans, or ongoing monthly active soccer-community users. Proprietary deduplication not independently verified.

observations.population: Those unique FIFA World Cup-related YouTube viewers who watched on television sets
observations.limitations: Explicit subset of the 1.7 billion tournament event viewers; do not add this to the full event audience.

observations.population: All videos related to the FIFA World Cup across the platform
observations.limitations: Lifetime view events from many World Cups; not distinct 2026 viewers, not an annual total and not FIFA's channel alone.

observations.period: Yearly total disclosed 2026-07-21; precise 12-month window not stated
observations.population: YouTube's defined sports content category, all sports
observations.limitations: All sports viewing, not unique sports fans, soccer fans, or paid viewing hours. Reporting window unspecified.

observations.population: YouTube videos related to the National Football League
observations.limitations: NFL refers to American football, not association football. Views cannot be treated as unique fans or added to total sports watch hours.

observations.population: Official YouTube broadcasts of the 2026 FIFA World Cup final
observations.limitations: Average simultaneous audience per minute, not cumulative unique viewers or peak concurrent viewers.

observations.population: Global videos related to handmade jewelry with DIY in the title
observations.limitations: Topic/title filtered, not every craft video or distinct jewelry maker.

observations.population: Global videos related to polymer clay with miniature in the title
observations.limitations: Title/filter-defined viewing events; can overlap crafts and art categories, not unique people.

observations.population: Global videos with draw with me or #drawwithme in their titles
observations.limitations: Title-term-defined view count, not a survey of artists or unique hobbyists.

observations.population: Global videos with paint with me or #paintwithme in their titles
observations.limitations: Title-term-defined view count, not representative of all watercolor or art channels.

observations.population: Global videos with bento box or #bentobox in their titles
observations.limitations: First-half title-term viewing volume, not number of cooking viewers.

observations.population: Global videos containing buldak and ramen in their titles
observations.limitations: Both-term filter, not all ramen-related videos; cannot compare directly with a broader 2026 category.

observations.population: Global videos related to sewing machines with beginner in their titles
observations.limitations: Restricted topic plus title, not all fashion creator supply or new sewer population.

observations.population: One specific Baby Shark Dance music video on YouTube
observations.limitations: Lifetime views of a single children's music video, not a community or individual child count. Do not infer user ages, households or child-directed classifications of other videos. A music video is not automatically an animated video.

observations.population: Videos related to video essays in YouTube's topical grouping
observations.limitations: 2024 title/topic activity, not 2026 demand, the size of essay audiences, distinct channels or creator earnings.

observations.population: Videos uploaded in 2025 with upcycle or upcycling in title
observations.limitations: Title-filtered upload volume, not creator count, video views, all DIY/craft uploads, unique buyers or revenue.

observations.population: NASA primary Artemis II mission livestream only
observations.limitations: A prominent specific spaceflight stream, not science viewing overall, unique viewers, creator work hours or channel earnings.

observations.population: Videos uploaded with 'morning routine' or 'morningroutine' in the title (not all lifestyle videos)
observations.limitations: A text-filtered six-month upload count, not unique creators, audience, channel popularity, gender-associated viewership or profit; some videos overlap several topics.

observations.population: Publisher-defined learning and how-to content in the United States during June 2025
observations.limitations: A broad publisher-defined single-month viewing event count, not a narrow science, tech or finance audience, unique people, a 2026 view series, creator income or tutoring business demand.

rules: Cumulative lifetime views, one-year views, watch hours, and survey percentages are different measurements.
Nested counts and overlapping topics must not be summed.
Commissioned animation fan samples do not represent the full national or platform audience.
This dataset cannot establish median creator earnings, monetization rates, or unique people in a subculture.
Published dates and category definitions must be preserved in any comparison.
The August 24 2026 view-count revision requires a measurement-version field before comparing view counts across the boundary.
Event-unique viewers are not an estimate of permanent community membership, and TV reach is a subset of total event viewers.
Live average-minute audience is not equivalent to cumulative unique viewers or peak concurrency.
Single-video lifetime totals must not be interpreted as an entire topic's activity or distinct people's viewing.
